If Underworld Charm is Your Thing, You will Dig it
Jan 2019 • Couples
This rooftop bar is centrally located in Nha Trang, close to beaches, bars and other restaurants. Views are nice and the place is relatively clean. The set up is great with coffee tables and comfortable sofa loungers.

It has the strongest and biggest nitrous balloons in town and cheap beer. 

But.....It seems to be run by some Russian mafia types that kind of make people a bit uncomfortable. They are there every night, simply watching and pretending to partake as normal guests, but these guys are clearly "management" or at the very least boyfriends of the staff. 

Just kind of a weird vibe. Not to mention the hot girl who walks around, table to table encouraging male guests to buy her balloons.

If seedy bars are your thing, perfect for you.
